parsed.main_gap: A minor off-by-one error occurs in bounding the cardinality of terminal members.

errors.description: The product over D without p has |D|-1 prime factors, so the valid bound is 2^{|D|-1} ≤ w(D\{p}), not 2^{|D|}. The corrected bound still implies |D| is bounded and completes the argument.

parsed.notes: Apart from this easily repaired inequality, the support reduction, self-duality, sunflower argument, descent, finiteness of minimal supports, and final periodicity deduction are coherent and complete.
